name: SPECIAL MEETING OF THE BEAUTIFICATION AND MAINTENANCE COMMISSION
agenda_text:
SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  BEAUTIFICATION AND MAINTENANCE COMMISSION

  LOCATION:
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  (562) 865-6262

  DATE
  THURSDAY, February 9, 2023
  7:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

SPECIAL PROCEDURES

In order to reduce the risk of spreading coronavirus (COVID-19) and pursuant to the
Governor’s Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20, public observation and
participation will be facilitated by the following means:

Members of the public may observe and provide public comments in-person in the City
Council Chambers subject to posted COVID-19 protocols. Public comments may also
be submitted by email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us or by leaving a voicemail at
(562) 865-6262, extension 200. Comment submitted before 4:00 p.m. on the date of
the meeting will be read until the time limit of three minutes has been reached.

Comments on topics that are not on the agenda must be received prior to the start of
general public comment. Comments on items on the agenda must be received prior to
the start of the relevant agenda item.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING PUBLIC COMMENTS
Public comments received prior to the commencement of the meeting will be read at
this time. Any public comments that cannot be heard within the next 20 minutes will be
heard at the end of the meeting. If a member of the public submitted public comments
on an item on the agenda, the public comment will be read at that time. Under the
provisions of the Brown Act, the Beautification and Maintenance Commission is

  1
 prohibited from taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer
the matter to staff or to a subsequent meeting.

OLD BUSINESS

  1. Adopt the Minutes from the following meetings: September 29, 2022 –
  Special Meeting

NEW BUSINESS

  2. Staff Review of CAL FIRE Grant Activities: UFMP, Tree Ordinance, Tree
  Planting, Tree Removal at Hibbing
  3. Request for Commission Assistance for Volunteer Tree Planting at
  Hibbing Street
  4. Request for Commission Assistance for City’s Earth Day/Arbor Day Event
  April 22, 2023

PUBLIC WORKS MANAGER COMMENTS

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS

  Adjournment to the next Regular Beautification and Maintenance Commission
  Meeting to be held on Thursday, April 20, 2023 at 6:00 P.M.

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please
contact City Hall at (562) 865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
